stty -F /dev/ttyS1 115200 crtscts -echo -onlcr
cat /dev/ttyS1 &
echo 1 > /sys/devices/platform/soc/soc\:odm/soc\:odm\:mcu_ctrl/turn_on
echo 1 > /sys/devices/platform/soc/soc\:odm/soc\:odm\:mcu_ctrl/reset
echo 1 > /sys/devices/platform/soc/soc\:odm/soc\:odm\:mcu_ctrl/long_wake_out
echo -ne "at+sm=lock\r\n" > /dev/ttyS1
